title: ION Trade Consideration Schema Pack v1
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 mirror of the trade/consideration/v1 OpenAPI schema pack. The root resolves to IONTradeConsideration; TradeConsideration provides the network-agnostic layer inherited from RetailConsideration v2.1.

TradeConsideration.title: TradeConsideration
TradeConsideration.description: Network-agnostic generic layer for TradeConsideration. Inherits RetailConsideration v2.1 without adding properties.

IONTradeConsideration.title: IONTradeConsideration
IONTradeConsideration.description: ION-specific extension of TradeConsideration. Refines inherited breakup taxDetail objects with the shared IONTaxDetail schema.

breakup.description: Inherited RetailConsideration price breakup, refined so each taxDetail object may carry IONTaxDetail classification and compliance fields.
